sources.notes: Para 67 repeals the earlier fraud risk management instructions for Commercial Banks, listed in circular DoS.CO.PPG.66/11.01.005/2026-27 of 31.07.2026; this replaces the RBI Master Directions on Fraud Risk Management of 15.07.2024 (RBI/DOS/2024-25/118, NotificationUser.aspx?Id=12702, formerly source rbi-frm-md-2024 / citation RBI-FRM-MD-2024), which RBI lists among the circulars withdrawn by the Department of Supervision.
